title.en: Operations research and formulation of an LPP
title.kn: ಕಾರ್ಯಾಚರಣೆ ಸಂಶೋಧನೆ ಮತ್ತು ರೇಖೀಯ ಯೋಜನಾ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಯ ರಚನೆ

heading.en: Making the best of limited resources

hook.en: A furniture unit in Channapatna has only so many machine hours and so much wood. How many chairs and how many tables should it make for the largest profit? Operations research turns such questions into mathematics: a linear programming problem.
hook.kn: ಚನ್ನಪಟ್ಟಣದ ಒಂದು ಪೀಠೋಪಕರಣ ಘಟಕಕ್ಕೆ ಸೀಮಿತ ಯಂತ್ರ ಗಂಟೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಮರವಿದೆ. ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಲಾಭಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ಕುರ್ಚಿ, ಎಷ್ಟು ಮೇಜು ಮಾಡಬೇಕು? ಕಾರ್ಯಾಚರಣೆ ಸಂಶೋಧನೆ ಇಂತಹ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳನ್ನು ರೇಖೀಯ ಯೋಜನಾ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಯಾಗಿ ರೂಪಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: State the meaning and uses of operations research
Identify decision variables, objective function and constraints
Formulate an LPP from a word problem

narration.en: A furniture unit in Channapatna has only so many machine hours and so much wood. How many chairs and how many tables should it make for the largest profit? Operations research turns such questions into mathematics: a linear programming problem.

body.en: Operations research (OR) applies scientific and quantitative methods to decision problems, to find the best (optimal) use of limited resources. It began with military operations in the Second World War. A linear programming problem (LPP) is an OR model in which a linear objective function of the decision variables is maximised or minimised subject to linear constraints and non-negativity restrictions.
body.kn: ಕಾರ್ಯಾಚರಣೆ ಸಂಶೋಧನೆ ಸೀಮಿತ ಸಂಪನ್ಮೂಲಗಳ ಅತ್ಯುತ್ತಮ ಬಳಕೆಗೆ ವೈಜ್ಞಾನಿಕ ಪರಿಮಾಣಾತ್ಮಕ ವಿಧಾನ. ರೇಖೀಯ ಯೋಜನಾ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ರೇಖೀಯ ಉದ್ದೇಶ ಫಲನವನ್ನು ರೇಖೀಯ ನಿರ್ಬಂಧಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಋಣೇತರ ಷರತ್ತುಗಳಿಗೆ ಒಳಪಟ್ಟು ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಅಥವಾ ಕನಿಷ್ಠಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತೇವೆ.

points.en: Decision variables: the unknown quantities (x, y)
Objective function: profit to maximise or cost to minimise
Constraints: limits on resources; x, y ≥ 0

narration.en: Operations research (OR) applies scientific and quantitative methods to decision problems, to find the best (optimal) use of limited resources. It began with military operations in the Second World War. A linear programming problem (LPP) is an OR model in which a linear objective function of the decision variables is maximised or minimised subject to linear constraints and non-negativity restrictions.
narration.kn: ಕಾರ್ಯಾಚರಣೆ ಸಂಶೋಧನೆ ಸೀಮಿತ ಸಂಪನ್ಮೂಲಗಳ ಅತ್ಯುತ್ತಮ ಬಳಕೆಗೆ ವೈಜ್ಞಾನಿಕ ಪರಿಮಾಣಾತ್ಮಕ ವಿಧಾನ. ರೇಖೀಯ ಯೋಜನಾ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ರೇಖೀಯ ಉದ್ದೇಶ ಫಲನವನ್ನು ರೇಖೀಯ ನಿರ್ಬಂಧಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಋಣೇತರ ಷರತ್ತುಗಳಿಗೆ ಒಳಪಟ್ಟು ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಅಥವಾ ಕನಿಷ್ಠಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತೇವೆ.

narration.en: The teacher turns a production problem into a table and then into an objective function and constraints.

say.en: Products A and B use two machines. Put the data in a table first.
Let x and y be the numbers of A and B made. These are the decision variables.
The profit row gives the objective: maximise 40 x plus 30 y.
Each machine row gives a constraint: hours used cannot exceed hours available.

body.en: 1. Identify the decision variables and give them symbols. 2. Write the objective function as a linear expression in them (Max for profit, Min for cost). 3. Write each limitation as a linear inequality: "at most" gives $\le$, "at least" gives $\ge$. 4. Add the non-negativity restrictions $x \ge 0$, $y \ge 0$. Uses of OR: production planning, diet planning, transport, inventory, allocation of workers and advertising media.
body.kn: ಹಂತಗಳು: ನಿರ್ಣಯ ಚರಗಳನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ; ಉದ್ದೇಶ ಫಲನ ಬರೆಯಿರಿ; "ಹೆಚ್ಚೆಂದರೆ" ಗೆ ≤, "ಕನಿಷ್ಠ" ಕ್ಕೆ ≥ ನಿರ್ಬಂಧಗಳು; x, y ≥ 0 ಸೇರಿಸಿ.

narration.en: 1. Identify the decision variables and give them symbols. 2. Write the objective function as a linear expression in them (Max for profit, Min for cost). 3. Write each limitation as a linear inequality: "at most" gives ≤, "at least" gives ≥. 4. Add the non-negativity restrictions x ≥ 0, y ≥ 0. Uses of OR: production planning, diet planning, transport, inventory, allocation of workers and advertising media.
narration.kn: ಹಂತಗಳು: ನಿರ್ಣಯ ಚರಗಳನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ; ಉದ್ದೇಶ ಫಲನ ಬರೆಯಿರಿ; "ಹೆಚ್ಚೆಂದರೆ" ಗೆ ≤, "ಕನಿಷ್ಠ" ಕ್ಕೆ ≥ ನಿರ್ಬಂಧಗಳು; x, y ≥ 0 ಸೇರಿಸಿ.

caption.en: Try a production plan: choose x units of A and y units of B and check the machine hours and profit.

narration.en: Choose how many of each product to make. If a slack becomes negative, the plan uses more hours than the machine has and is not feasible.

tryThis.en: Find a plan with profit above ₹2600 that keeps both slacks ≥ 0. Can you?
Try x = 50, y = 0 and x = 0, y = 80.
Which plan uses all hours of both machines?

problem.en: A dealer has ₹5760 to buy fans (₹360 each) and sewing machines (₹240 each) and space for at most 20 items. Profit is ₹22 per fan and ₹18 per machine. Formulate the LPP.

steps.en: Let x = fans, y = sewing machines.
Space: x + y ≤ 20; and x ≥ 0, y ≥ 0.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. A dealer has ₹5760 to buy fans (₹360 each) and sewing machines (₹240 each) and space for at most 20 items. Profit is ₹22 per fan and ₹18 per machine. Formulate the LPP.

heading.en: Read the inequality from the words

body.en: "Not more than", "at most", "available", "capacity" → ≤. "Not less than", "at least", "minimum requirement" → ≥. Profit → Max; cost → Min.

narration.en: Read the inequality from the words. "Not more than", "at most", "available", "capacity" → ≤. "Not less than", "at least", "minimum requirement" → ≥. Profit → Max; cost → Min.
Class quiz. Discuss with your neighbour, then the monitor taps the class answer.
narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಪಕ್ಕದವರೊಂದಿಗೆ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ನಂತರ ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

narration.en: Now two questions in the pattern of the II PUC Statistics board exam. Try them on your own first, then check.

points.en: OR finds the best use of limited resources.
points.kn: ಕಾರ್ಯಾಚರಣೆ ಸಂಶೋಧನೆ ಸೀಮಿತ ಸಂಪನ್ಮೂಲಗಳ ಉತ್ತಮ ಬಳಕೆ ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: LPP: linear objective + linear constraints + x, y ≥ 0.
points.kn: LPP: ರೇಖೀಯ ಉದ್ದೇಶ + ರೇಖೀಯ ನಿರ್ಬಂಧಗಳು + x, y ≥ 0.

points.en: Profit is maximised; cost is minimised.

homework.en: Formulate: a diet needs at least 8 units of protein and 12 of fat; food P (₹20/kg) has 2 and 2 units, food Q (₹30/kg) has 1 and 4 units per kg.

narration.en: Recap. OR finds the best use of limited resources. LPP: linear objective + linear constraints + x, y ≥ 0. "At most" gives ≤; "at least" gives ≥. Profit is maximised; cost is minimised.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಕಾರ್ಯಾಚರಣೆ ಸಂಶೋಧನೆ ಸೀಮಿತ ಸಂಪನ್ಮೂಲಗಳ ಉತ್ತಮ ಬಳಕೆ ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. LPP: ರೇಖೀಯ ಉದ್ದೇಶ + ರೇಖೀಯ ನಿರ್ಬಂಧಗಳು + x, y ≥ 0. "ಹೆಚ್ಚೆಂದರೆ" ≤; "ಕನಿಷ್ಠ" ≥. ಲಾಭ ಗರಿಷ್ಠ; ವೆಚ್ಚ ಕನಿಷ್ಠ.
